policy_feature.content: fixed encoder output of the frozen policy for the snapshot history, then last action (4), t/horizon, queue fraction
policy_feature.source: branches/inputs/<scene>.npz, array t<checkpoint>_policy_feature (saved once per snapshot before any continuation)

preprocessing: StandardScaler(policy_feature) -> PCA(8) -> StandardScaler(PC scores) -> append checkpoint one-hot [12, 52, 92, 132]
fit_on: unique training snapshots of the fold only, before repeats are expanded
never_an_input: scene / episode id, seed, stage, host, driver, file name, path, hash, snapshot id, repeat id
cube pose, grasp / on-cube / static flag, stage label
success or failure, trunk outcome, success step, final state, any arm outcome or count
T_ref, R5 duration, achieved displacement, state after the return, future trace or noise
